pages.lesson:
LESSON: SCRIPTURAL TEXT AND ROLE OF SIKH SCRIPTURES SAHIB IN SRI GURU GRANTH SAHIB JI 17

Grade: Grade 9
Subject: HINDU RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
Strand: Strand 2
Topic 2.1: Scriptural Text and role of Sikh Scriptures sahib in Sri Guru Granth Sahib ji 17

SECTION 1: WELCOME

Hello! Today we learn about Scriptural Text and role of Sikh Scriptures sahib in Sri Guru Granth Sahib ji 17. Read the explanation, study the examples, do the practice, then try the revision quiz.

Big question: How do the Scriptures influence your lifestyle?

SECTION 2: WHAT YOU WILL LEARN

By the end of this lesson, you will be able to:

1. explain the compilation of Sri Sukhmani Sahib in Sri Guru Granth Sahib ji for internalisation

SECTION 3: LEARN STEP BY STEP

1. explain the compilation of Sri Sukhmani Sahib in Sri Guru Granth Sahib ji for internalisation
   In simple words: practise until you can explain the compilation of Sri Sukhmani Sahib in Sri Guru Granth Sahib ji for internalisation. Use examples from school and home in Kenya.

SECTION 4: EXAMPLES

Example 1: Talk about Scriptural Text and role of Sikh Scriptures sahib in Sri Guru Granth Sahib ji 17 using something you see at school in Kenya.

Example 2: Give a home example from your county, estate, or village.

Example 3: Teach a younger child one idea from this lesson in simple words.

SECTION 5: TRY THIS

1. Underline two new ideas about Scriptural Text and role of Sikh Scriptures sahib in Sri Guru Granth Sahib ji 17 in the examples.
2. Explain Scriptural Text and role of Sikh Scriptures sahib in Sri Guru Granth Sahib ji 17 to a parent using one local example.
3. Draw or write three things that show you understand Scriptural Text and role of Sikh Scriptures sahib in Sri Guru Granth Sahib ji 17.
4. Show that you can: explain the compilation of Sri Sukhmani Sahib in Sri Guru Granth Sahib ji for internalisation

SECTION 6: WORK TO DO (PRACTICE & REVISION)

1. Write five sentences about Scriptural Text and role of Sikh Scriptures sahib in Sri Guru Granth Sahib ji 17 using examples from school or home.
2. Answer: Why is Scriptural Text and role of Sikh Scriptures sahib in Sri Guru Granth Sahib ji 17 important for a Grade 9 learner?
3. Make a one-minute oral presentation to a parent or teacher.
4. List three ways you will practise this topic this week.

SECTION 7: CLASS ACTIVITY IDEAS

1. Discuss the compilation of the Sri Guru Granth Sahib ji,
2. Conduct research using digital media/digital media with assistive technology library/ magazines on the compilation of Ashtpadi from 17-24 from Sri Sukhmani Sahib in Sri Guru Granth Sahib ji
3. Listen to the audio/video recitation of Sri Sukhmani Sahib for correct pronunciation
4. Learning to Learn: learner enhances knowledge while interacting with resource persons in the role of Sri Guru Granth Sahib ji.
5. Patriotism: learner exhibits devotion when writing an essay on Sri Guru Granth Sahib ji's role in a devotee’s life.

SECTION: THINK ABOUT IT

1. How do the Scriptures influence your lifestyle?
2. How does the recitation of the Scriptures help to acquire self-efficacy?

SECTION: REMEMBER

1. explain the compilation of Sri Sukhmani Sahib in Sri Guru Granth Sahib ji for internalisation

Now complete the Revision Quiz. Open the Answers tab only after you finish.

— CBC Learn · Original learner lesson from KICD outcomes (Strategy 2)
